verdict.rationale: RevenueCat documents automatic application of intro/free-trial offers (auto-conversion) and promotional entitlement grants, plus generic webhooks for event notifications, but there is no vendor documentation of coupon/promo-code management or of trial-end reminder notifications specifically required by card-network rules — and community evidence explicitly flags this as an unmet feature request ('handling timed hooks to send notifications... reminding users before a trial expires'). missing for 10: dedicated coupon/promo-code support docs, explicit trial-end notification feature (beyond generic webhooks), and confirmation the community-requested reminder capability now exists.
